en: A monochrome winter landscape showing a snowy rural valley with scattered houses and villas on gently rolling hills. Leafless trees dot the foreground, fences and telegraph poles trace the roads, and a few larger mansion‑like buildings stand on the ridge in the background. The scene is calm and fully covered in snow. In the upper left corner, there is printed text in a serif font.
